markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (89%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Simulated resampled frozen section is flagged unreliable, leaves InSitu unexcluded, and triggers drafted recut and deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 89%, InSitu 10%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% [F1] | Favors Invasive; calibrated (5% ECE) |
| Conformal set | {InSitu, Invasive} at 90% coverage (validation 90%, n=132) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 30% (AUROC 0.70), OOD 100%, 12 regions [F6] | Flagged suspect input; extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (69%–76% similarity) [F5]; InSitu contrast 68% | Neighbors match; InSitu contrast close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.62 contribution; 19/20 AI spot-check) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (+0.57 contribution), Unreliable 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.57 contribution), weak and Unreliable 0/20 spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.47 contribution; 18/20 spot-check), caption-inconsistent · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Descriptive only (8/20 AI spot-check); cell segmentation disabled · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section artifact (severity 3) makes in situ carcinoma (contrast case BACH_0077, 68% similarity) mimic invasion.
- Validated stromal invasion is scarce (-0.62), while pro-invasive signals rely on Unreliable mitoses and normal-lobule detectors.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 8**: Highest classifier risk (100%); verify true stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 5, 9**: High risk (99%–100%); inspect for duct-confined atypia despite Unreliable mitoses and necrosis scores.
3. **Regions 7, 11**: Check tubules and lobules; defer margins (98%–100% segment scores) to permanent sections [F7].
